obj.unary.name: Unary modifier
obj.unary.desc: Applies a modifier to the incoming signal.
obj.timer.name: Timer
obj.timer.desc: Delays the input signal by N seconds
obj.timer.act.1.desc: Input signal will be delayed by N seconds.
obj.splitter.name: Splitter
obj.splitter.desc: Splits the input signal into two tethers
obj.junction.name: Junction
obj.junction.desc: Does not modify signal that passes through.
obj.junction.act.1.desc: The signal will not be modified.
obj.bin.name: Binary combinator
obj.bin.desc: Applies a certain binary operation to input signals.
obj.bin.act.6.desc: Applies the binary operation of negated AND
obj.bin.act.7.desc: Applies the binary operation of negated OR
obj.wires.name: Damaged wiring
obj.wires.desc: Highly vulnerable wiring. Cyberwasps will attempt to damage it, causing fluctuations in the network.
obj.wires.act.1.desc: Constantly outputs 0 when being ravaged by a cyberwasp.
obj.btn.name: Floor button
obj.btn.desc: Is triggered by stepping on it or putting a heavy object on it.
obj.btn.act.1.desc: Triggered by any object being on the button
obj.btn.act.2.desc: Triggered by a player stepping on the button
obj.btn.act.3.desc: Triggered by a heavy cube being on the button
obj.laser_rx.name: Laser receiver
obj.laser_rx.desc: Outputs 1 when a correct laser ray is received.
obj.laser_rx.act.2.desc: Activated by a ray of certain color.
obj.laser_rx.act.3.desc: Activated by any ray other than selected color.
obj.lever.name: Lever
obj.lever.desc: Outputs a new signal based on state.
obj.lever.act.1.desc: Changes state after being interacted with.
obj.conveyor.name: Conveyor
obj.conveyor.desc: Constantly moves objects and entities according to settings.
obj.conveyor.act.2.desc: Conveyor will be moving objects counter clockwise.
obj.conveyor.act.3.desc: Conveyor will not move regardless of signal.
obj.exit.name: Exit door
obj.exit.desc: Exit through this door to complete the puzzle.
obj.laser.Blue.name: Laser source (Blue)
obj.laser.Blue.act.1.desc: Emits a constant ray when activated.
obj.laser.Blue.act.2.desc: Emits a short ray when activated.
obj.laser.Yellow.name: Laser source  (Yellow)
obj.laser.Yellow.act.1.desc: Emits a constant ray when activated.
obj.laser.Yellow.act.2.desc: Emits a short ray when activated.
obj.laser.Red.name: Laser source  (Red)
obj.laser.Red.act.1.desc: Emits a constant ray when activated.
obj.laser.Red.act.2.desc: Emits a short ray when activated.
obj.laser.Purple.name: Laser source  (Purple)
obj.laser.Purple.act.1.desc: Emits a constant ray when activated.
obj.laser.Purple.act.2.desc: Emits a short ray when activated.
obj.door.name: Door
obj.door.desc: This door may be a hindrance to you
obj.spawner.name: Object spawner
obj.spawner.desc: Spawns chosen object upon receiving 1. The object will be destroyed upon receiving 0.
obj.spawner.act.1.desc: Will not spawn any objects but will be able to destroy them regardless
obj.shield.name: Shield generator
obj.shield.desc: Creates a magnetic field repelling nearby cyberwasps.
obj.shield.act.1.desc: Creates the shields. Only requires one impulse of signal.
obj.teleport.name: Teleport
obj.teleport.desc: Can (almost) instantly teleport objects and entities through channels.
obj.teleport.act.1.desc: Teleports objects to a teleport on the same channel. If there are more than two teleports in the channel, it will fail.
obj.speaker.name: Speaker box
obj.speaker.desc: Emits a loud sound for sound detectors upon receiving 1.
obj.sound_rx.name: Детектор звука
obj.sound_rx.desc: Засекает все звуковые сигналы поблизости и излучает сигнал.

note.level8:
<color=red>DIARY RECORDING // DAMAGED</color>


No, it can't be! I've spent so long working on this project and all in vain.
Enough for me... I'll finish this experiment, no matter what it costs! Either now, or never! They will understand how wrong they were when they see the machine in action. I'll become the best inventor in the whole world!
note.level8.1:
<color=yellow>CREW DIALOGUE RECORDING</color>

- Today the wasps in the Reactor Block looked off. They just turned on by themselves during the charging time, and started flying around aimlessly.
- Damn it, they've always seemed kind of strange to me. We should tell the Captain about this accident.
- Already told a couple of constructors about it, but you know how they are. They aren't going to waste their time helping us. Especially considering how much work they have already. 
- Either way, the more bears know about it, the better. Especially the higher ups. Be careful, and good night.
- I'll do all I can. Good night.


<color=yellow>END OF RECORDING
note.level9:
To: <color=red>(CONFIDENTIAL)</color>
From:  <color=#99c6f7>Energetic Research Center</color>


We have looked at your suggestion of an AI-based robotic technology. We sadly have to deny it due to a high risk of harming the station personnel. Artificial Intelligence has still not been fully researched and requires more time for testing. However we are sure that you can achieve success soon. We will be ready to review your suggestion again, once the machine is thoroughly tested and certified.
